kanto.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

original-johto.flavorText: The negatively charged ions generated in its fur create a constant sparking noise.

hoenn.flavorText: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur’s static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the fur on its body as if it were sharp needles.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

updated-johto.flavorText: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.

original-unova.flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

updated-unova.flavorText: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.

kalos.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Jolteon’s cells generate a low level of electricity. This power is amplified by the static electricity of its fur, enabling the Pokémon to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

original-alola.flavorText: When its fur stands on end, that’s a sign it’s about to give off a jolt of electricity. Take care, as sometimes lightning strikes next to it, too.

updated-alola.flavorText: Its fur stands on end, becoming like needles it fires at enemies. Once they’re weakened, it finishes them off with a 10,000 volt shock.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A sensitive Pokémon that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.

swsh.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

pla.flavorText: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
